cards.text: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah becomes king of Israel. He reigns in Samaria nine years. Nine years, friend, and most of my cookies don't last nine MINUTES.

cards.question: True or false: King Hoshea of Israel does even more evil than the kings of Israel who came before him.

cards.text: Then Shalmaneser, king of Assyria, attacks Hoshea, and Hoshea becomes his vassal and pays him tribute. Basically, Hoshea's got a subscription he can't cancel, and Assyria is sending the bill.
But Hoshea conspires to send envoys to King So of Egypt.

cards.question: True or false: Hoshea stops paying the king of Assyria the tribute he paid in previous years.
The king of Assyria discovers Hoshea's plan with Egypt and the missing tribute. What does he do to Hoshea?

answers.text: Arrests him and puts him in prison
Makes him pay double the next year
Sends him away to live in Egypt

cards.text: With Hoshea in prison, the king of Assyria invades the whole land and marches up to Samaria.

cards.question: The king of Assyria reaches Samaria. What does he do to the city?

answers.text: Passes it by on his way to Egypt

cards.question: Samaria has been under siege for three years. What happens in the ninth year of Hoshea?

answers.text: The king of Assyria captures Samaria
Assyria's army gives up and goes home

cards.question: After Samaria falls, the king of Assyria carries the Israelites away to ___.

cards.text: He settles them in Halah, in Gozan by the Habor River, and in the cities of the Medes. And the question hanging over all of it, friend, is WHY.
Now the writer pauses the story to tell us why. All this happened because the people of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God.

cards.question: The writer reminds us the LORD brought Israel out from under the hand of Pharaoh. Out of which land?
True or false: The writer says the people of Israel worshiped other gods.

cards.text: They walk in the customs of the nations the LORD drove out before them, and in practices the kings of Israel brought in. They even do things in secret against the LORD their God that are not right.

cards.question: Israel builds high places in all their cities, from watchtower to fortified city. Where do they set up sacred pillars and Asherah poles?

answers.text: On every high hill and under every green tree
In hidden rooms inside the palace
Along the banks of the Jordan River

cards.text: They burn incense on the high places, just like the nations the LORD drove out. And they serve idols, even though the LORD had told them, "You shall not do this thing."
Yet the LORD warns Israel and Judah through all His prophets and seers. Not one or two, friend. ALL of them.

cards.question: Through His prophets and seers, what does the LORD tell Israel and Judah to do?

answers.text: Turn back and keep His commandments
Make peace with the king of Assyria
Build up Samaria's walls for war

cards.question: True or false: Israel listens to the prophets.

cards.text: Instead they stiffen their necks like their fathers, who did not believe the LORD their God. Friend, I've been that stubborn with an oven timer, and I have the burnt batches to prove it.

cards.question: Israel pursues worthless idols and becomes worthless themselves. They go after the surrounding nations too. What had the LORD commanded them about those nations?

cards.text: They abandon ALL the commandments of the LORD their God, and they make idols for themselves.

cards.question: Along with an Asherah pole, what idols does Israel make for themselves?

answers.text: A bronze serpent on a pole

cards.text: They bow down to all the host of heaven and serve Baal, a false god. Friend, this list just keeps going.
This part is heavy, friend. They sacrifice their sons and daughters in the fire, and they practice divination and soothsaying.

cards.question: True or false: The writer says Israel's evil provokes the LORD to anger.

cards.text: Now here's where it all lands, friend. The LORD is very angry with Israel, and He removes them from His presence.

cards.question: After the LORD removes Israel from His presence, only the tribe of ___ remains.
True or false: The tribe of Judah lives by the customs Israel introduced.

cards.text: So the LORD rejects all the descendants of Israel. He afflicts them and hands them over to plunderers, until He has banished them from His presence.
Then the writer hits rewind to the day the kingdom split. When the LORD tore Israel away from the house of David, they made Jeroboam son of Nebat king.

cards.question: What does King Jeroboam do to Israel?

answers.text: Leads them away from following the LORD
Leads them back to the house of David
Leads them out of the land to Egypt

cards.question: True or false: After Jeroboam, the Israelites finally turn away from the sins he committed.
Finally, the LORD removes Israel from His presence. How had He declared this would happen?

answers.text: Through all His servants the prophets
Through a dream given to Hoshea
Through a sign written on a wall

cards.text: So Israel is exiled from their homeland into Assyria, and they're still there when this was written.
